EB05-046.name: 大和
EB05-046.effect:
若對手有原本力量值8000以上的角色卡時，這張角色卡獲得【防禦】，力量值+3000。
【對方攻擊時】可以廢棄1張自己的手牌：若自己廢棄區有10張以上卡片時，自己的領航卡原本的力量值，在這個回合變更成7000。
EB05-046.effect_en:
If your opponent has a Character with a base power of 8000 or more, this Character gains [Blocker] and +3000 power.
[On Your Opponent's Attack] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If you have 10 or more cards in your trash, your Leader's base power becomes 7000 during this turn.

OP18-112.name: 火燒山
OP18-112.effect: 【防禦】(對手攻擊後，將這張卡片置為休息狀態即可使攻擊的對象換成這張卡片)
OP18-112.effect_en: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
